description: This file defines the ModuleConditionalResource class, which models a conditionally loaded resource in an OpenMRS module, based on platform version and required modules. It includes nested class ModuleAndVersion that specifies module dependencies with versions.

classes.name: ModuleConditionalResource
classes.description: Represents a resource that loads conditionally based on OpenMRS platform version and modules.

classes.name: ModuleAndVersion
classes.description: Inner class representing a module's identifier and version necessary for conditional resource loading.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path of the resource.

methods.name: setPath
methods.description: Sets the path of the resource.

methods.name: getOpenmrsPlatformVersion
methods.description: Returns the specified OpenMRS platform version for conditional loading.

methods.name: setOpenmrsPlatformVersion
methods.description: Sets the OpenMRS platform version required for the resource.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves the list of module dependencies.

methods.name: setModules
methods.description: Sets the list of module dependencies.
